services: db: image: docker.io/library/postgres:15 environment: POSTGRES_DB: smartcity_complaints POSTGRES_USER: postgres POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password ports: - "5433:5432" volumes: - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data restart: unless-stopped healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d smartcity_complaints"] interval: 5s timeout: 3s retries: 10

frontend: build: context: ./frontend containerfile: Containerfile ports: - "5173:5173" environment: - VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8080/api
